subject: Problem with rhinit() and installation tests

messages.author: 81685c0005399943
messages.subject: Problem with rhinit() and installation tests
parts:
Hi,

I was trying to test Rhipe installation on my hadoop cluster of 7
nodes. I am talking about Rhipe version 0.65.4.

After issuing library(Rhipe) command on R, i issued rhinit() command,
which keeps on running i.e. i didn't get the next R prompt till next
half an hour nor any error. (Then i stopped the process)

After that i tried basic installation tests for which the results are
as follows:

> rhwrite(list(1,2,3),"/tmp/x",1)
Error in if (info) { : argument is of length zero


map <- expression({
lapply(seq_along(map.values),function(r){
x <- runif(map.values[[r]])

rhcollect(map.keys[[r]],c(n=map.values[[r]],mean=mean(x),sd=sd(x)))
})
})
z <- rhmr(map, ofolder="/tmp/test", inout=c(’lapply’,’sequence’),
N=10,mapred=list(mapred.reduce.tasks=0),jobname=’test’)

rhex(z)

# After rhex(z) , I got this:
----------------------------------------
Running: /home/hadoop/Desktop/Cloudera/hadoop-0.20.2-cdh3u1/bin/
hadoop jar /usr/local/lib/R/library/Rhipe/java/Rhipe.jar
org.godhuli.rhipe.RHMR /tmp/RtmpMNmygL/rhipe67360558
----------------------------------------
Error in if (rhoptions()$mode == "current") { :
argument is of length zero

>


and rhoptions showed me this:

> rhoptions()$mropts[[1]]
NULL
>


I am very new to R and Rhipe, I was strictly trying to follow the
Rhipe documentation for the whole process.

Please help.

Thanks,

Dipesh
